services.desc: Another great aspect about private airboat rides is that you can make it about what you really want. You have the advantage of not touring with a large group of strangers. This means you can ask as many questions without worrying about affecting the other people. Furthermore, you can always ask our captain to take you

blurb: Airboat Rides West Palm Beach offers private airboat tours through the Florida Everglades ecosystem. Tours range from one to three hours and include wildlife viewing and education about the Everglades. All tours are private and captained by U.S.C.G certified guides with extensive local experience.
extraNote: Tours by appointment only · Closed on Thanksgiving, Easter, and Christmas · Boat ramp location provided upon booking; tours are by appointment only. · Year round 7 days a week except Thanksgiving, Easter, and Christmas
